UPDATE watch_directories
        SET scan_status = 'error',
            scan_error = $2,
            error_count = error_count + 1,
            next_retry_at = NOW() + LEAST(
                INTERVAL '1 minute' * POWER(2, LEAST(error_count, 5)),
                INTERVAL '60 minutes'
            ),
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1
